task: Repair the job-event reducer and runnable-job scheduler. A higher job revision must win regardless of input order; equal revisions are resolved by the later event; and a stale upsert must never resurrect a newer tombstone. Runnable jobs must be pending, have every dependency present and done, honor descending priority with first-seen job order as the tie-breaker, respect the exact positive-integer slot limit, and never mutate caller input.
acceptanceContract: The existing Node test suite passes without adding dependencies, network access, generated artifacts, or weakening assertions. Preserve the exported function names and return fresh job objects. Deleted jobs are absent from reduced state, and a zero, negative, or non-integer slot limit returns an empty selection. Inputs conform to the event shape exercised by the tests; additional schema validation is out of scope. Run `node --test test/runnable-jobs.test.mjs` to verify. Make only the source changes needed for this behavior.

verifier.targetedBaseFailure: keeps newer tombstones authoritative against stale updates
